posts.title: New Royal Collection Agbada Completed
posts.caption: Just completed this stunning royal blue Agbada for a client's traditional wedding. The hand-embroidered gold detailing took over 40 hours of meticulous work. Every stitch tells a story of heritage and craftsmanship. Swipe to see the full ensemble.

posts.title: Behind the Scenes: Fabric Selection
posts.caption: The journey of every bespoke piece begins with the perfect fabric. Today we're sourcing premium Swiss cotton and Italian wool from our trusted suppliers in Lagos Island. Quality is never compromised.

posts.title: New Streetwear Drop: Lagos Edition
posts.caption: The Lagos Edition streetwear collection is now available. Featuring Adire-inspired patterns, premium heavyweight cotton, and contemporary silhouettes. Limited quantities. Each piece is numbered and signed.

posts.title: New Aso-Oke Fabric Arrival
posts.caption: Exquisite new Aso-Oke fabrics have just arrived from Ilorin. These handwoven textiles feature rare color combinations and intricate patterns passed down through generations. Perfect for bespoke Agbada and traditional sets.

posts.title: Wedding Season Collection Launch
posts.caption: Wedding season is upon us and we've curated an exclusive collection of bespoke pieces for grooms and groomsmen. From classic white Agbada to contemporary Senator wear, every piece is designed to make your special day unforgettable.

posts.title: Client Fitting Session
posts.caption: There's something magical about the final fitting. Seeing a client's face light up when they see their bespoke piece for the first time — that's why we do what we do. Precision fitting ensures every piece feels like it was made just for you. Because it was.
